entries.text: Very well, Champion Nemona. I trust you to\nhandle this in my stead.[VAR 0x0114(002C)]
entries.label: champ_0010_chairman_01

entries.text: Sure thing! You can count on me. In fact, I bet\nthis is gonna be fun![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: champ_0010_rival_00

entries.text: I’m glad to hear it. Good day, then.[VAR 0x0114(002C)]
entries.label: champ_0010_chairman_02

entries.text: Oh—pardon me.[VAR 0x0114(002C)]
entries.label: champ_0010_chairman_03

entries.text: Who was that?
entries.label: champ_0010_select_03

entries.text: She looked awesome!
entries.label: champ_0010_select_04

entries.text:
Piqued your interest, huh? That lady is...
Well, they call her La Primera!\c
She’s strong, she can do pretty much anything,
she’s got cool practically coming out her ears...\c
She’s basically everything I wanna be—or that
any Pokémon Trainer would wanna be, really![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: champ_0010_rival_16a

entries.text:
Good eye! She sure is! That lady is... Well, they
call her La Primera!\c
She’s strong, she can do pretty much anything,
she’s got cool practically coming out her ears...\c
She’s basically everything I wanna be—or that
any Pokémon Trainer would wanna be, really![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: champ_0010_rival_16b

entries.text: Oh! Which reminds me! Remember in homeroom\nwhen I asked what your dream is?[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: champ_0010_rival_17

entries.text: Now, I know you said you’re all about completing\nthe Pokédex! But hear me out...[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: champ_0010_rival_02a

entries.text: Well, since your heart’s already set on becoming\na really strong Trainer...I’ve got an idea for you![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: champ_0010_rival_02b

entries.text: If you’re still trying to decide what it is you’re\nlooking for...I’ve got an idea for you![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: champ_0010_rival_02c

entries.text: You should try to reach [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Champion Rank[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] like me![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: champ_0010_rival_03

entries.text: Yeah, I will!
entries.label: champ_0010_slect_01

entries.text: I don’t know...
entries.label: champ_0010_slect_02

entries.text: Oh wow! Hang on, though—I’ve got a whole spiel\nI wanna give you. Here goes...[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: champ_0010_rival_04a

entries.text: Aww, but talent like yours deserves to be used!\nHear me out...[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: champ_0010_rival_04b

entries.text:
The Trainers who reach Champion Rank are the
ones who raise their Pokémon really strong.\c
They’re pro-tier battlers. Their moves keep
crowds absolutely on the edge of their seats![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: champ_0010_rival_05

entries.text: You have to prove yourself to the Pokémon\nLeague to officially get the title of Champion.[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: champ_0010_rival_06

entries.text:
And to do that, you have to do more than just
take classes here.\c
You’ve got to take on eight Pokémon Gyms and
win so you can collect their Gym Badges![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: champ_0010_rival_07

entries.text: Once you’ve done all that, all that’s left is a\nspecial test—the Champion Assessment.[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: champ_0010_rival_08

entries.text: And once you pass THAT, then at long last you’ll\nbe a Champion![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: champ_0010_rival_09

entries.text: It’s every Pokémon Trainer’s dream! The coolest\ntitle anyone could ever hope to get!\c\nNot to brag or anything![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: champ_0010_rival_10

entries.text: I reached Champion Rank during our last\nTreasure Hunt, you know![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: champ_0010_rival_11

entries.text:
Oh, the Treasure Hunt is a special independent
study thing we’ve got here. Should happen soon!\c
Our last one started not long after the beginning
of this school year![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: champ_0010_rival_16

entries.text: It’s great! You get to leave school to go have an\nadventure and learn however you want![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: champ_0010_rival_12

entries.text: I guess you could say my journey to becoming\na Champion was the treasure I found...maybe?\r\nI dunno yet if that’s the answer I’m looking for...[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: champ_0010_rival_13

entries.text: Anyway, I’ve got a feeling I’d be able to get even\nstronger if you and I were both working at it...[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: champ_0010_rival_14

entries.text: Lemme go ahead and save the Gyms’ locations in\nyour map app in case you decide to go for it![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: champ_0010_rival_18

entries.text: Give it some thought![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: champ_0010_rival_15
